title: Vienna demonstration for Julian Assange
location: Vienna, march from Karlsplatz toward Stephansplatz (search-rendered description)
threshold_50_evidence: VIENNA.AT reports around 250 demonstrators; this is above the 50-person threshold. It is an approximate single-source estimate, not a verified exact count.

occurrence_and_date.summary: The article states a Vienna demonstration took place Tuesday 20 February 2024 during the London hearings.

location.summary: March began at Karlsplatz and proceeded via the Staatsoper, Heldenplatz, Ballhausplatz and Michaelerplatz to Stephansplatz.

organizer.summary: The article identifies GGI as organizer and names Monika Henninger-Erber as an organizer.

demands.summary: Organizer requested more engagement by Austria’s government and support for Assange’s release; article says release of Assange was the sole substantive focus. This fits political_behavior_process.

participants_original.summary: Around 250 participants, per the report; one approximate source estimate.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: The reported estimate of around 250 is above 50.

protester_violence.summary: Inspected story section does not report protester violence; this absence in limited coverage does not establish no violence. Keep unknown.

state_response.summary: Inspected story section does not report any of the seven state response dimensions. All remain unknown.

notes: Body-reviewed event evidence supports a public gathering above 50 and an explicit request that Austria’s government engage more in the Assange extradition matter. Code as a candidate pending independent scientific review. Foreign actors were involved in the underlying case, but the organizer also explicitly targeted Austria’s government.
